labs.title: Create and publish an HR agent in Microsoft Copilot Studio
labs.summary: Create HR Helper in a simulated Copilot Studio portal, add internal SharePoint knowledge, author a time-off topic, test, publish, and connect Microsoft channels.
labs.scenario: Contoso needs an internal HR agent. In the **simulated Microsoft Copilot Studio** portal, create **HR Helper** with a description and instructions that use a friendly tone, answer only HR policy questions, and escalate personal cases to HR. Add knowledge from **https://hr.contoso.example/sites/hr** as an internal SharePoint source, not a public site. Keep **Use generative AI orchestration for your agent's responses?** set to **Yes**. Create a blank topic named **Request time off** with trigger phrases, a multiple-choice **Question** node for **Vacation**, **Sick leave**, and **Other** saved to **varTimeOffType**, a **Condition**, and **Message** nodes. Test knowledge and topic behavior in **Test your agent**, publish, add **Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot**, and set **Settings > Security > Authentication** to **Authenticate with Microsoft**.
learningObjectives: Create and configure a Copilot Studio agent
Ground agent answers in an internal SharePoint knowledge source
Build and test a topic with Question, Condition, and Message nodes
Publish an agent to Microsoft 365 channels with Microsoft authentication
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with agents, topics, and organizational knowledge sources

steps.title: Create HR Helper
steps.instruction: Open **Agents**, select **+ Create**, and configure **HR Helper** with HR-scope instructions and **Use generative AI orchestration for your agent's responses? = Yes**.
steps.explanation: The agent name, description, instructions, and orchestration mode control the agent behavior.

rules.description: HR Helper exists with generative orchestration
rules.failureFeedback: Create HR Helper and keep generative orchestration on.

steps.title: Add HR SharePoint knowledge
steps.instruction: On **Knowledge**, select **+ Add knowledge**, choose **SharePoint**, and add **https://hr.contoso.example/sites/hr** named **Contoso HR policies**.
steps.explanation: SharePoint is the approved internal HR source and can respect user permissions.

rules.failureFeedback: Add the HR SharePoint source only.

steps.title: Test a grounded answer
steps.instruction: Open **Test your agent** and ask `What does the bereavement policy say?`; confirm the answer cites **Contoso HR policies**.
steps.explanation: Testing validates that the agent retrieves from the configured knowledge source.

rules.failureFeedback: Ask an HR policy question after adding knowledge.

steps.title: Create the Request time off topic
steps.instruction: On **Topics**, select **+ Add a topic** > **From blank**. Name it **Request time off**, add leave trigger phrases, add a **Question** node with **Vacation**, **Sick leave**, and **Other**, save to **varTimeOffType**, then add a **Condition** and **Message** nodes.
steps.explanation: A topic is best for structured HR requests that need a specific answer before branching.

rules.failureFeedback: Create the topic with the required Question node and variable.

steps.title: Test the topic
steps.instruction: In **Test your agent**, send `I need to request time off` and confirm the topic asks for the leave type.
steps.explanation: Testing verifies the trigger selects the authored topic.

rules.failureFeedback: Ask for time off after creating the topic.

steps.title: Publish, add channels, and set authentication
steps.instruction: Select **Publish**, add **Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot** from **Channels**, keep **Make agent available in Microsoft 365 Copilot** selected, and set **Settings > Security > Authentication** to **Authenticate with Microsoft**.
steps.explanation: Publishing updates connected channels; Microsoft authentication is appropriate for internal Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot agents.

labs.solution:
1. Select **Agents** > **+ Create**.
2. Set **Name** to `HR Helper`; write HR policy description and instructions that answer only HR policy questions and escalate personal cases to HR. Keep **Use generative AI orchestration for your agent's responses?** as **Yes**.
3. Open **Knowledge**, select **+ Add knowledge**, choose **SharePoint**, name it `Contoso HR policies`, and enter `https://hr.contoso.example/sites/hr`.
4. Open **Test your agent** and ask `What does the bereavement policy say?`; confirm a cited HR policy answer.
5. Open **Topics**, select **+ Add a topic** > **From blank**, name it `Request time off`, add leave trigger phrases, add a **Question** node with **Vacation**, **Sick leave**, and **Other**, save to `varTimeOffType`, then add a **Condition** and **Message** nodes.
6. Test with `I need to request time off`.
7. Select **Publish**.
8. Open **Channels**, add **Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot**, and keep **Make agent available in Microsoft 365 Copilot** selected.
9. Open **Settings > Security > Authentication**, choose **Authenticate with Microsoft**, and save.
